title: Decision On Mass Struggle
definition: The strategic shift in the Indian National Congress (INC) from constitutional agitation and petitioning to the adoption of 'Mass Struggle' (Satyagraha/Non-Cooperation) as the primary instrument for achieving Swaraj.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is central to understanding the transition from the Moderate phase to the Gandhian era, testing the evolution of political ideology, mass mobilization techniques, and the internal debates within the INC.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Decision On Mass Struggle.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Impact of WWI on Indian Economy
